mcqs.question: In a cellular system, the entire service area is divided into small geographic units called ______.

options: Reducing the number of base stations

mcqs.question: With 120-degree sectoring, the number of first-tier co-channel interfering cells reduces from six to ______.

options: The average call duration in the busy hour
The number of channels per cell
The total traffic carried by the system
The probability that a call is blocked during the busiest hour

mcqs.question: In the Erlang B model, a call that arrives when all channels are busy is ______.
options: Cleared (blocked and removed) from the system
Queued until a channel is free
Assigned a channel of another cell

mcqs.question: In the Erlang C model, a blocked call is ______.
options: Queued until a channel becomes available
